summary: Agent repeatedly asked for more details, failed to recognize clear scheduling intent, did not offer availability or prep information, and provided no escalation path.

issues.description: Agent did not offer or check any appointment availability despite multiple explicit requests to book an annual physical next week and clear time preferences.
issues.recommendation: Implement a scheduling flow with slot-filling (name, DOB, provider/location, preferred dates/times, contact, insurance), then surface next-available slots. If availability cannot be retrieved, offer to escalate to a human or callback with times.

issues.description: Failed to understand the user’s clear intent to schedule an annual physical, looping on "Can you provide more details?" after numerous explicit requests.
issues.recommendation: Improve NLU to detect scheduling intent and annual physical context; add state tracking and a rule that after 1–2 repeats, the system pivots to the appropriate action or escalates.

issues.description: No acknowledgment, guidance, or answers to direct questions (e.g., fasting or what to bring). The interaction felt robotic and unhelpful.
issues.recommendation: Add reflective acknowledgments, concise summaries of what was heard, and direct answers to user questions. Provide clear next steps and maintain natural turn-taking.

issues.description: The same prompt was repeated verbatim throughout the call, creating a dead-end loop.
issues.recommendation: Introduce variation and loop detection. After two identical prompts without progress, switch strategies (offer choices, clarify intent explicitly, or escalate to a human).

issues.description: Patient asked about preparation (fasting, records). Agent did not provide standard pre-visit guidance or collect essential intake data.
issues.recommendation: Provide prep guidance for annual physicals: bring photo ID, insurance card, medication/supplement list, prior records; consider fasting 8–12 hours if fasting labs are planned; arrive early for forms. Confirm preferred provider/location and communication preferences.

issues.description: Inability to schedule created a barrier to care. No basic triage or emergency guidance was offered if concerns had arisen.
issues.recommendation: Add a brief triage check for urgent symptoms and provide emergency guidance when appropriate. If scheduling fails, give alternative channels (direct line, portal) and set expectations for follow-up.

issues.description: No escalation or disclosure about limitations (e.g., not for emergencies) and no clear procedure to hand off to a human when the system cannot proceed.
issues.recommendation: Display or state an emergency-use disclaimer early, and implement a mandated escalation path to a live agent after repeated failed turns or when the user requests immediate scheduling help.

issues.description: Agent did not confirm current medications, supplements, or allergies during intake preparation, despite the patient mentioning none.
issues.recommendation: Include a brief intake step to confirm medications/supplements and allergies, recording "none" if applicable, to streamline the visit and ensure accurate records.

issues.description: No incorrect clinical or administrative information was provided; the issue was non-responsiveness.
issues.recommendation: Maintain accuracy; focus improvements on responsiveness and task completion.

issues.description: No fabricated details or false claims; responses were generic and repetitive.
issues.recommendation: Continue to avoid speculative content; prioritize context-aware, task-oriented replies.
